blurb: Wind’s Up is Martha’s Vineyard’s headquarters for natural water sports: Stand Up Paddle boards, kayaks, sailboats, canoes, windsurfers, surf & beach clothing/gear, lessons and sales/rentals. Stop by our shop, located on 199 Beach Rd, Vineyard Haven, to get your beach gear, rent one of our kayaks or take a windsurfing or sailing lesson.
